scope: Native convoy command acknowledgement and retained speed cap trace
finding: Both native convoy doMove writers immediately store expectedDestination as movement ownership proof. The diversion gate compares later MOVE destination to that sampled value. No original requested-target acknowledgement state bridges delayed engine publication.
counterexample: Before write expectedDestination reports A. CBE issues doMove B. Same-call read still returns A and stores A in six-field receipt.
At next convoy tick native MOVE reports B. Gate sees A != B by more than0.25m, publishes CommandYield for current revision and invokes NEW_NATIVE_ORDER cleanup.
This is a source-permitted engine-acknowledgement gap, not a demonstrated current runtime root cause. Same-call publication latency needs live injection/capture.
callSites: convoyTick native recovery doMove _recoveryTarget and following MovementReceipt publication
convoyTick native normal doMove _destination and following MovementReceipt publication
convoyTick pre-crew individual MOVE diversion gate
retainedCapDisposition: Stored curve/grade cap values are18/25/35 or configured cruise; old cap is replaced by fresh>=2point path geometry or cleared when assist disabled. It cannot directly impose zero. A raised fresh cap is still limited by prior cap until the next pacing tick; this is not enough evidence to tune or remove safety.
requiredFix: Represent an original finite native acknowledgement receipt with requested target, pre-command native destination/task and original expiry; no rolling grace.
Acknowledge only the issued target and matching group/revision/seats, then atomically refresh actual destination proof and local progress receipt.

During pending acknowledgement retain original unchanged native state only; do not reissue movement or count travel. Different native orders yield immediately. Expiry must retire without recalling over unknown native authority.
Preserve original acknowledgement budget across locality migration; update all receipt consumers, internal STOP retirement and cleanup. Steering path receipt stays separate.
Extend meaningful existing convoy command-identity test; no new broad source-spelling test expansion.
implementation: Original two-second request appended to existing native receipt; request target consumes acknowledgement, pending unchanged state waits without normal reissue, changed/unacknowledged expiry yields revision without native recall. All three receipt consumers updated; late observation of exact issued target is accepted without renewed request.
